abilities.name: CYBER CAGE
abilities.description: INSTANTLY toss the cyber cage in front of Cypher. Activate to create a zone that blocks vision and slows enemies who pass through it.

abilities.name: SPYCAM
abilities.description: EQUIP a spycam. FIRE to place the spycam at the targeted location. RE-USE this ability to take control of the camera's view. While in control of the camera, FIRE to shoot a marking dart. This dart will Reveal the location of any player struck by the dart. This ability can be picked up to be REDEPLOYED.

abilities.name: TRAPWIRE
abilities.description: EQUIP a trapwire. FIRE to place a destructible and covert tripwire at the targeted location creating a line that spans between the placed location and the wall opposite. Enemy players who cross a tripwire will be tethered, revealed, and dazed after a short period if they do not destroy the device in time. This ability can be picked up to be REDEPLOYED.

abilities.name: NEURAL THEFT
abilities.description: INSTANTLY use on a dead enemy player in your crosshairs to reveal the location of all living enemy players.
